name: 08759 · Manchester, NJ
findings: ZIP 08759 (Manchester) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08759 (Manchester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
